evals.prompt: Summarize all my open GitHub PRs and issues from the last month and create a SummaryReport.md with outstanding actions and recommendations.
evals.expected_output: A SummaryReport.md is written to the current directory containing: high-priority outstanding actions section, tables of open PRs organized by recency, tables of open issues, and a recommendations section with immediate/short-term/medium-term buckets.
expectations: SummaryReport.md is created in the current working directory
Report contains a 'Outstanding Actions' or 'High Priority' section
Report contains tables or lists of open PRs with URLs
Report contains tables or lists of open Issues with URLs
Reviewer comments with action requests are quoted or summarized in the report
gh search prs and gh search issues commands are used to gather data

evals.prompt: What do I need to do on GitHub this week? Check my open PRs and issues and tell me what's waiting for attention.
evals.expected_output: The skill fetches open PRs/issues, examines comment threads, and produces a SummaryReport.md. The response highlights the most urgent items (reviewer requests, unanswered questions) and gives a concise summary of what needs attention.
expectations: Outstanding reviewer requests are identified from comment threads
Items with comments are fetched in detail using gh pr view or gh issue view
Each high-priority item has a concrete recommended action
DRAFT PRs that are ready to promote are noted

evals.prompt: Generate my monthly GitHub status report — open PRs, open issues, what's blocked, what has outstanding review comments I haven't addressed yet.
evals.expected_output: A SummaryReport.md organized by section, with merge dependencies called out, blocked items identified, and for complex issues, detailed notes written to an issues/ subdirectory.
expectations: Merge dependencies between PRs are identified if present
Items older than 30 days are listed separately from recent items
For issues with long comment threads, a detailed notes file is created in issues/ subdirectory
Stale PRs (>1 year old) are flagged with a recommendation to close or rebase
